title: How Metalworking Abrasives Improve Productivity | Tru-Maxx — MSC Industrial Supply Co.
summary: MSC's Alex Logan, Category Manager, and Brad Heraghty, National Account Manager, discuss how Tru-Maxx helps manufacturers with abrasives applications.
body_markdown:

Tru-Maxx gives manufacturers access to a broad range of industrial-quality abrasives designed to deliver reliable performance at a customer-friendly cost. In this episode of *Tooling Up* , host Toni Neary talks with Alex Logan of MSC Industrial Supply and Brad Heraghty, National Account Manager, to explore how Tru-Maxx supports metalworking applications, from cutting and grinding to surface preparation, finishing, and precision work.


The conversation also looks beyond purchase price to the bigger picture of abrasive performance, including productivity, throughput, and selecting the right solution for the application. Alex and Brad explain how Tru-Maxx’s breadth of products, combined with MSC’s Metalworking Specialists and supplier expertise, can help manufacturers simplify abrasive selection and find the right balance of performance, productivity and cost.
